battle.name: 兩山戰役
battle.theater: 雲南河口至廣西崇左對越邊境
battle.brief: 兩山戰役是中文維基《戰爭列表》所列的中越邊境衝突，1979年2月起由中國與越南在雲南、廣西對越一帶交戰，涵蓋邊境攻擊與後續對峙。Berdan rifle（別丹步槍）於1866年已列裝，年代早於1979年，但不是本役主要交戰裝備；此項只說明符合年份限制的裝備背景，並不作使用推定。

kit.name: 別丹步槍
kit.history: 別丹步槍是蘇軍承接的制式步槍體系，主要置於步兵班組，提供步兵的通用射擊能力，並非裝甲、航空或海軍裝備。

countries: 本篇所稱「兩山戰役」，專指1979年2月17日至3月16日發生在雲南與廣西兩條邊境戰線的中越交戰。交戰國為中華人民共和國與越南社會主義共和國。中方由昆明軍區負責雲南方向、廣州軍區負責廣西方向；雲南方面以曼埃、孟定、勐臘和保山附近的邊防陣地為起點，廣西方面則以友誼關、憑祥、東興、龍州及寧明附近的邊防陣地為起點。越軍以第二軍區、第四軍區分別承擔雲南與廣西方向的防務，並由正規步兵師支援前線。戰場主體在越南北部，少部分追擊行動越過中越或中老邊界。
countriesEn: The term “Two Mountains Campaign” in this account refers specifically to the Sino-Vietnamese fighting on the Yunnan and Guangxi border fronts from 17 February to 16 March 1979. The belligerents were the People's Republic of China and the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam. On the Chinese side, the Kunming Military Region handled Yunnan and the Guangzhou Military Region handled Guangxi. In Yunnan, the operation began near the border positions at Man'ei, Mengding, Mengla and Baoshan, while in Guangxi it began near those at Youyiguan, Pingxiang, Dongxing, Longzhou and Ningming. Viet Nam's Second and Fourth Military Regions undertook the defenses in Yunnan and Guangxi respectively, with regular infantry divisions reinforcing the forward units. Most fighting took place in northern Viet Nam, although limited pursuit operations crossed either the Sino-Vietnamese or Sino-Lao frontier.
people: 北京中樞由鄧小平批准作戰方案，中央軍委作戰指揮部由楊得志任總指揮，張愛萍等參與統籌；廣西方向由廣州軍區司令員許世友指揮，雲南方向則由昆明軍區司令員張銖秀及各軍指揮部執行。雲南方面主要投入第十三、第十四、第十五軍所屬部隊，公開戰史常列第37、第38、第39、第40、第41、第42及第43師。廣西方面以第41軍第121、第122、第123師，第43軍第129、第130師，以及第55軍第179師為主要突擊兵力。越軍採取邊防警衛團與步兵師相互配合的編制，雲南方向常見第146、第148邊防團，廣西方向常見第327、第328、第330團。前線由軍、師、團、營逐級指揮，連與排分別負責突擊、爆破、警戒、搜索及傷員後送。
peopleEn: At the central level, Deng Xiaoping approved the operational plan, and the Central Military Commission command headquarters was headed by Commander Yang Dezhi, with Zhang Aiping and others coordinating the effort. The Guangxi front was directed by Guangzhou Military Region commander Xu Shiyou, while the Yunnan front was directed by Kunming Military Region commander Zhang Zhixiu and the relevant army headquarters. The Yunnan force principally comprised units of the 13th, 14th and 15th Armies. Published campaign histories commonly list the 37th, 38th, 39th, 40th, 41st, 42nd and 43rd Infantry Divisions. The principal assault formations in Guangxi were the 121st, 122nd and 123rd Divisions of the 41st Army, the 129th and 130th Divisions of the 43rd Army, and the 179th Division of the 55th Army. The Vietnamese force combined border guard regiments with regular infantry divisions. The 146th and 148th border guard regiments were commonly encountered in Yunnan, while the 327th, 328th and 330th Regiments appeared in Guangxi. Command passed from army to division, regiment and battalion, with companies and platoons assigned to assault, obstacle clearance, security, reconnaissance and casualty evacuation.
kits: 前線常見的制式裝備，中方步兵以五六式步槍、六七式手榴彈和五六式輕機槍為主，步槍彈藥為7.62×39毫米，輕機槍彈藥為7.62×54毫米R；炮兵使用五九式100毫米坦克炮、五四式及五九式122毫米榴彈砲、五六式120毫米迫擊砲，步兵分隊還攜帶82毫米迫擊砲及一二七式高射機槍。裝甲與運輸主力包括五九式坦克、六二式輕型坦克、解放CA10B中型卡車及BJ212吉普車，空軍投入殲-6作戰機與米-8直升機。越軍使用AK-47、AKM、PKM、RPG-7及DShK通用機槍，裝甲包括T-54與T-55坦克，炮兵配備M2A1型105毫米榴彈砲及2B11型120毫米迫擊砲，常見彈藥包括7.62×39毫米、7.62×54毫米R、12.7×99毫米、100毫米、105毫米、120毫米及122毫米口徑。後勤上，雲南物資由昆明、保山經公路送抵曼埃、孟定、勐臘等集結區，廣西物資則利用南寧鐵路與公路轉送憑祥、東興及龍州；團、營設前進彈藥所，道路受阻的最後一段以人背、馬馱補足，傷員由救護車或輕型車輛向後送。
kitsEn: Typical PLA equipment included Type 56 rifles, Type 67 grenades and Type 56 light machine guns. Rifle ammunition was 7.62×39 mm, while the light machine guns used 7.62×54 mmR ammunition. The artillery arm fielded the Type 59 100 mm tank gun, Type 54 and Type 59 122 mm howitzers and the Type 56 120 mm mortar, while infantry formations also carried 82 mm mortars and Type 67 heavy machine guns. The principal armored and transport equipment consisted of Type 59 tanks, Type 62 light tanks, Jiefang CA10B medium trucks and BJ212 jeeps, with J-6 fighters and Mi-8 helicopters providing air support. Vietnamese troops used AK-47 and AKM rifles, PKM machine guns, RPG-7 launchers and DShK general-purpose machine guns. Their armor included T-54 and T-55 tanks, while their artillery included M2A1 105 mm howitzers and 2B11 120 mm mortars. Common ammunition calibers on both sides included 7.62×39 mm, 7.62×54 mmR, 12.7×99 mm, 100 mm, 105 mm, 120 mm and 122 mm. Logistically, supplies for Yunnan moved from Kunming and Baoshan by road to assembly areas around Man'ei, Mengding and Mengla. In Guangxi, they were transferred through Nanning by rail and road toward Pingxiang, Dongxing and Longzhou. Regimental and battalion forward ammunition depots were established, with porters and pack animals covering the final sections where roads were blocked. Ambulances and light vehicles carried casualties toward the rear.
tactics: 2月17日拂曉，中方先以炮兵和航空兵對已知越軍陣位實施短時間火力準備，工程兵隨即在步兵掩護下排除地雷、鐵絲網及其他障礙，突擊分隊再以小組沿火力缺口進入陣地。五九式坦克只隨突破分隊有限投入，未在雷區正面密集展開；步兵奪取陣地後，炮兵立即轉移射擊至新目標，後勤分隊同時修復道路、補給彈藥並建立救護站。越軍由外露的邊界哨位退入山丘射擊位，以機槍、迫擊砲、反坦克武器及預設雷區交叉封鎖通道，並利用夜戰、伏擊和預備隊反擊消耗中方前出部隊。中方後續以炮兵連續壓制、殲-6對道路與縱深陣位實施攻擊、由後方調入生力軍鞏固突破口。戰役後期，部分追擊部隊越入老撾北部，但補給線延伸與前線戰鬥同時增加了指揮壓力。撤退階段則先後撤傷員及非必要裝備，主力分批北返，最後由後衛掩護炮兵和交通隊伍離開戰區。
tacticsEn: At first light on 17 February, the PLA opened with a short period of artillery and aviation fire against known Vietnamese positions. Combat engineers then removed mines, wire and other obstacles under infantry protection, after which small assault groups entered through gaps in the fires. Type 59 tanks were committed only in limited strength with the breakthrough formations and were not massed directly across mined approaches. After the infantry occupied a position, artillery fire was shifted to the new target while logistics units repaired roads, replenished ammunition and established treatment stations. The Vietnamese forces withdrew from exposed border posts into firing positions on the hills, where machine guns, mortars, anti-tank weapons and prepared minefields created intersecting fields of fire. They also used night attacks, ambushes and reserve counterattacks to wear down the leading Chinese troops. The PLA responded with sustained artillery suppression, J-6 strikes against roads and deeper positions, and fresh formations brought forward to consolidate captured ground. Late in the campaign, some pursuit units entered northern Laos, although extension of the supply route increased command pressure while fighting continued. During the withdrawal, casualties and nonessential equipment were moved first, the main body then withdrew in separate formations, and rear-guard troops covered the artillery and transport units as they left the battle area.
data: 2月14日，北京批准作戰方案；2月16日，軍方發布在雲南、廣西方向實施自衛還擊的公告，部隊隨後進入臨戰位置。2月17日拂曉，中越兩國邊防陣地爆發交火。2月18日至20日，中方相連奪取曼埃、猛醒、友誼關、憑祥及東興一帶的多處邊防陣位，搜索部隊開始向越軍縱深追擊。2月21日至27日，越南以第二、第四軍區的預備隊實施反擊，雙方在山丘陣地、道路與預備隊展開地反覆爭奪。2月27日前後，第四軍區方向出現較集中的越軍反擊，中方由後方調動部隊封住突破口。3月上旬，越南北部與老撾方向的中方追擊隊伍陸續撤回。3月5日，河內提出停火並要求中國撤軍，雙方隨後就停火與撤出安排接觸。3月14日，中國宣布自3月16日起全面撤軍；3月16日，最後一批中方部隊完成北返，零星交火亦告停止。各方公布的傷亡總數因統計時間、是否包括後送傷員及陣亡-definition不一致而有出入，本篇不把任何單一傷亡總表列為定論。
dataEn: On 14 February, Beijing approved the operational plan. On 16 February, the military authorities announced that self-defense counterattack operations would begin in Yunnan and Guangxi, and the troops moved into their final predeployment positions. Fighting broke out along the border defenses at first light on 17 February. From 18 to 20 February, Chinese forces successively seized border positions around Man'ei, Mengxing, Youyiguan, Pingxiang and Dongxing, while search units began pursuing Vietnamese forces into the interior. From 21 to 27 February, Viet Nam committed reserves from its Second and Fourth Military Regions in counterattacks, producing repeated struggles over hill positions, roads and reserve routes in both sectors. Around 27 February, the Fourth Military Region mounted a more concentrated Vietnamese counterattack, and China shifted additional troops forward to close the penetration. In early March, Chinese pursuit formations in northern Viet Nam and Laos gradually withdrew. On 5 March, Hanoi proposed a ceasefire and requested Chinese withdrawal, after which the two sides discussed the cease-fire and withdrawal arrangements. China announced a general withdrawal beginning on 16 March, and the last Chinese formations completed their withdrawal north on 16 March as isolated clashes ceased. Published casualty totals differ because of reporting dates and inconsistent treatment of evacuated casualties and battlefield deaths, so this account does not present any single casualty total as conclusive.
cause: 戰爭的第一層背景是尚未正式完成的邊界劃定。中越邊界主要沿十九世紀末中法交涉所留下的線路形成，1887年及1895年的相關文件解決了若干地段，卻沒有消除全部爭議；1960年代中越談判亦未能完成全線劃界。1970年代後期，越南在若干地段前推邊防據點、加強壕溝和火力工事，中國邊防部隊則多次記錄越軍越界射擊及前沿接觸事件。外部因素在1978年底迅速升高。越南於12月25日出兵柬埔寨，1979年1月7日占領金邊，北京承認由西哈莫尼親王參與領導的民主柬埔寨政府並延續援助；河內則認為中國支持柬埔寨境內的舊武裝，擔心其與越南邊軍配合，形成對越南北部的壓力。北京把越軍在邊境的前進與射擊同越南對柬埔寨的軍事行動視為相互關聯，河內則強調中國援助、邊界談判停滯及中國在南部集結兵力所帶來的壓力。1979年1月至2月，雙方在外交與軍事層面連續交涉、示警和增兵，最終促使北京批准有限時間的邊境作戰。
causeEn: The first underlying cause was the absence of a fully settled boundary. Much of the Sino-Vietnamese frontier followed arrangements reached during Sino-French negotiations in the late nineteenth century. The relevant 1887 and 1895 instruments settled some sectors but did not remove every dispute, and Sino-Vietnamese talks in the 1960s did not produce a completed demarcation across the entire frontier. During the later 1970s, Viet Nam advanced border guard positions in several areas and expanded trenches and firing works, while Chinese border troops repeatedly recorded cross-border fire and direct contact with Vietnamese positions. External circumstances rose sharply at the end of 1978. Viet Nam entered Cambodia on 25 December and occupied Phnom Penh on 7 January 1979. Beijing recognized the Democratic Kampuchea government associated with Prince Sihanouk and continued assistance, while Hanoi regarded Chinese support for the remaining Cambodian forces as a possible source of pressure against northern Viet Nam. Beijing connected the forward movement and firing of Vietnamese border units with Viet Nam's military campaign in Cambodia. Hanoi, in turn, emphasized Chinese assistance, the stalled border negotiations and the concentration of Chinese forces in the south. From January to February 1979, the two sides engaged in repeated diplomatic, military and troop-positioning measures, culminating in Beijing's approval of a limited border operation.
impact: 作戰過程首先顯示，中方能在短期內集中大量炮兵、坦克與航空兵，但後方道路長、障礙排除量大，前沿醫療與分批補給也形成明顯壓力；越軍則以縱深射擊位、預備隊反擊與雷區阻滯了中方突破速度。戰後，解放軍加強了合成營、空地協同與戰區後勤演練，越軍把單薄的邊界哨位體系改造成前哨、支撐點和縱深反擊力量相配合的防禦架構。在冷戰格局中，交戰進一步加劇北京、莫斯科與河內之間的不信任，越南對蘇聯武器、援助及外交支持的依賴上升。越南並未因中越戰爭而放棄介入柬埔寨，其持續控制反而伴隨更廣泛的國際外交孤立、援助與貿易限制。中美在1979年建交後仍保持接觸，但華盛頓必須同時處理遏制蘇聯影響、維持對越貿易限制及接觸北京之間的政策平衡。邊界本身沒有因這場戰役得到重新劃定，雙方的軍隊部署和防衛密度則明顯增加。
impactEn: The fighting first showed that the PLA could concentrate substantial artillery, armor and aviation power in a short period, but it also exposed the pressure created by long rear routes, extensive obstacle clearance, forward medical support and echeloned resupply. The Vietnamese defensive system used depth firing positions, reserve counterattacks and minefields to slow the Chinese penetrations. After the campaign, the PLA emphasized combined-arms units, air-ground coordination and theater logistics, while the Vietnamese Army developed a more layered frontier structure linking outposts, supporting positions and depth counterattack forces. Within the Cold War alignment, the conflict intensified distrust among Beijing, Moscow and Hanoi, and Viet Nam's reliance on Soviet weapons, assistance and diplomatic backing increased. Viet Nam did not abandon its intervention in Cambodia because of the war with China; the continuation of that control instead coincided with broader diplomatic isolation and tighter aid and trade restrictions. After the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and the United States in 1979, Washington continued its contacts with Beijing while balancing containment of Soviet influence, restrictions on trade with Viet Nam and engagement with China. The frontier itself was not redrawn by the campaign, but both sides increased their deployments and defensive density.
result: 到3月16日，中方作戰部隊、隨行火炮、車輛及後勤分隊均已撤回中國，沒有部隊留駐越南北部或老撾；越軍重新控制原有邊境陣位，遭破壞的哨所和工事由雙方各自修復，戰俘亦依停火安排分批遣返。中方正式公告的目的限於反擊邊境武裝挑釁並迫使越軍退離前沿，實際上曾突破多處邊防、迫使越方投入預備隊，但未能在撤軍前迫使河內停止對柬埔寨的軍事政策，也未取得永久性領土。越方守住國土與主要防禦地帶，但為此承受部隊分散、前線反覆轉進及更大的外部壓力。中越官方對戰役性質的稱呼雖不相同，可核對的作戰記錄則顯示：戰役由中方發起，也在中方宣布並執行撤退時終止；越方未能阻止全部越境，卻在戰役結束時恢復了對本國邊疆的實際控制，兩國之間的邊界線則未因此改變。
resultEn: By 16 March, the PLA combat formations, accompanying artillery, vehicles and logistics units had withdrawn to China. No Chinese troops remained in northern Viet Nam or Laos. Vietnamese forces regained their original border positions, both sides repaired the damaged posts and defensive works, and prisoners were repatriated in accordance with the cease-fire arrangements. The officially stated Chinese purpose was limited to countering armed provocations along the frontier and compelling Vietnamese units to leave the forward areas. The operation did break through several Vietnamese positions and force the commitment of reserves, but it did not compel Hanoi to abandon its policy in Cambodia before the Chinese withdrawal. Viet Nam preserved its territory and principal defensive zones, but paid for that result through the dispersal of troops, repeated movement between the front and supporting positions, and increased external pressure. Although the two governments described the nature of the campaign differently, the operational record shows that China initiated the fighting and also ended it by announcing and carrying out the withdrawal. Viet Nam could not prevent every incursion, but by the conclusion it had restored effective control over its own frontier, and the boundary between the two countries remained unchanged.
